jobs.title: Senior Engineer AI Native Delivery
jobs.description: **At Taazaa** Working at Taazaa involves engaging with cutting\-edge technology and innovative software solutions in a collaborative environment. We emphasize continuous professional growth through workshops and training. Our employees often interact with clients to tailor solutions to business needs, working on diverse projects across industries. We promote work\-life balance with flexible hours and remote work options, fostering a supportive and inclusive culture. Competitive salaries, health benefits, and various perks further enhance the work experience. **1\. About the Role** We build and deliver software for clients who expect working systems, not slideware. This role sits within a delivery squad, you own features end to end, from shaping the specification through to production, and you do it with AI coding agents as a standard part of how you work. We're not looking for someone who has simply used Copilot. We're looking for an engineer who has changed how they build because of these tools: writing specifications an agent can execute against, reviewing generated code with real rigor, and knowing when to stop delegating and write it yourself. You should be language\-agnostic by nature. Most of our work is in .NET, Node.js, or Java, but the engineer we want treats the runtime as an implementation detail and picks up whatever the engagement requires. **2\. What You'll Do** * Own delivery of features and services end to end – design, build, test, deploy, and support. * Work directly with clients and product stakeholders to turn ambiguous requirements into specifications precise enough to build against. * Use AI coding agents as a primary tool: decompose work into agent\-executable units, drive them through implementation, and hold the output to the same review standards as human\-written code. * Contribute to and improve our Spec\-Driven Development practice – the specifications, prompts, agent configurations, and review checkpoints the whole team relies on. * Review peers' code and agent\-assisted output; raise design concerns early rather than at merge time. * Operate in Agile delivery: sprint planning, estimation, standups, demos, and retrospectives – with real participation, not just attendance. * Diagnose and fix production issues, including in code you didn't write. * Mentor mid\-level engineers on both engineering fundamentals and effective use of AI coding agents. **3\. What We're Looking For** *3\.1 Required* * 6\+ years building and shipping production software. * Deep hands\-on strength in at least one of .NET / C\#, Node.js / TypeScript, or Java with a genuine willingness to work outside it. * Demonstrated fluency with AI coding agents in real delivery work (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent) – not experimentation, but shipped outcomes. * Solid grasp of API design and testing practices. * Proficiency with RDBMS (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle) or NoSQL stores (MongoDB, DynamoDB, Cosmos DB) – including schema and data modeling, query performance, and knowing which fits the problem. * Real Agile experience in a team that actually practices it. * Cloud experience on at least one major platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP). * Strong written and verbal communication – you'll be working directly with clients. * Authorized to work in the US without sponsorship. *3\.2 Strongly Preferred* * Frontend capability (React, Angular, or Vue) sufficient to own a feature across the full stack. * Familiarity with Spec\-Driven Development or a comparable specification\-first workflow. * Experience across more than one language or runtime in production. * CI/CD, containers, and infrastructure\-as\-code exposure. * Consulting or client\-facing delivery background. *3\.3 Nice to Have* * Built internal tooling, agent skills, or automation that other engineers adopted. * Experience with LLM application patterns – RAG, evals, tool calling. * Domain exposure in healthcare, financial services, or retail/e\-commerce. **4\. Benefits** * Health, vision, dental, and life insurance * 401(k) with employer matching * Paid time off Pay: $110,000\.00 \- $140,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Referral program * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hudson, OH 44236

jobs.title: Senior Game Producer
jobs.description: TapBlaze is looking for a Senior Game Producer to help us run and scale production across Good Pizza, Great Pizza, Good Coffee, Great Coffee, and future titles. You will own production across our live games, turning product and creative direction into clear, executable plans and driving releases from approved concept through launch and post\-launch verification. Your responsibility is to make sure the complete player experience ships correctly and on time, not simply to update Jira or report status. You will work closely with the product leadership in Los Angeles while coordinating execution between our Los Angeles team and our publishing partner in Beijing. For major live events, platform featuring opportunities, content updates, and releases, you will be the person making sure every function is aligned, dependencies are visible, risks are surfaced early, and nothing falls between teams. **What You Will Own** ===================== **End\-to\-End Launch \& Release Ownership** -------------------------------------------- * Own production for major live events, features, content updates, platform promotions, and releases from approved concept through launch and post\-launch verification. * Build launch plans with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, content locks, QA windows, release candidates, and go/no\-go checkpoints. * Make sure Product, Engineering, Art, Narrative, QA, Localization, Marketing, and platform requirements come together as one coherent launch. * Surface risks early and drive tradeoff discussions with the appropriate product, creative, and functional owners. **Turn Designs Into Executable Production Plans** ------------------------------------------------- * Ensure approved design/product specifications are current, complete, and treated as the single source of truth. * Translate initiatives into clear Jira epics, tasks, owners, dependencies, and deadlines; partner with functional owners to refine technical and discipline\-specific subtasks. * Make sure Engineering and QA are never expected to implement or test from outdated Slack messages or ambiguous documentation. * Establish and enforce practical standards for design handoff, task readiness, change tracking, and acceptance criteria. **Cross\-Functional \& LA–Beijing Production** ---------------------------------------------- * Coordinate production between our Los Angeles team and our publishing partner in Beijing, keeping priorities, dependencies, handoffs, and deadlines aligned across time zones. * Create enough overlap and communication structure that issues spanning TapBlaze and our publishing partner are resolved without depending on the CEO to connect the pieces. * Partner with team members and functional leads at TapBlaze and our publishing partner to clarify ownership, escalate blockers, and improve accountability. * Be comfortable working across cultures and time zones; Mandarin and/or prior China/APAC game\-development experience is a strong plus. **QA, Localization \& Release Readiness** ----------------------------------------- * Ensure QA coverage, test planning, regression scope, release\-candidate timing, and critical launch coverage are planned before they become emergencies. * Make localization part of the production plan from the beginning, including source\-string completeness, deadlines, implementation, and verification. * Run lightweight launch\-readiness reviews for important releases and make unresolved risks explicit before launch. * Ensure post\-release smoke testing and verification are assigned and completed. **Production Systems \& Continuous Improvement** ------------------------------------------------ * Build simple, scalable production processes that improve clarity and accountability without creating unnecessary bureaucracy. * Own Jira and production documentation as tools for execution—not as ends in themselves. * Run postmortems when launches or processes break down, identify root causes, and turn lessons into durable process improvements. * Develop clear escalation paths and operating rhythms for live games, including major releases and critical incidents. **You’re a Great Fit If ...** ============================= * You have 5\+ years of game production experience, including meaningful ownership of shipped or live\-operated games. * You have strong experience with mobile f2p live games, recurring content, live ops, or similarly fast release environments. * You have led cross\-functional production across multiple disciplines rather than only managing schedules for a single team. * You are highly organized, but your value is judgment and ownership, not just task administration and coordination. We are not looking for project manager type producers. * You naturally ask what is missing, who owns it, what can block launch, and what needs to happen next. * You are comfortable challenging unclear requirements, incomplete handoffs, unrealistic schedules, and unowned dependencies. * You can operate effectively in a small, hands\-on studio where leaders are expected to solve problems rather than pass them between departments. * Production experience with distributed teams, co\-development partners, or publishers is strongly preferred. * Experience working with teams in China or APAC is strongly preferred; Mandarin is a plus. **What Success Looks Like** =========================== * Major launches have a clearly accountable owner, current source\-of\-truth documentation, complete Jira execution plans, task owners, dependencies, and readiness checkpoints. * Product, Engineering, QA, Localization, and Marketing are aligned before release rather than discovering conflicts at the end. * Cross\-time\-zone execution between our Los Angeles team and our publishing partner in Beijing becomes predictable and transparent. * Problems are surfaced and resolved by the production organization before they need CEO intervention. * The team learns from misses and improves the system so the same failure does not recur. **How We Work** =============== This is a full\-time, five\-day\-per\-week in\-office position at TapBlaze’s Los Angeles studio, with no remote or hybrid option. We believe this role is most effective when deeply embedded with the team and able to resolve issues quickly in person. We believe *beauty is in the details*. If you have read this far, include that phrase somewhere in your application. **Physical Requirements** ========================= * Los Angeles, CA: Reliably commute or relocate before starting work; * Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer. **Compensation** ================ The range for this role is $100,000 to $125,000 depending on experience, with the opportunity to earn an annual discretionary bonus. **Commitment to Diversity** =========================== As an equal opportunity employer committed to meeting the needs of a multigenerational and multicultural workforce, TAPBLAZE recognizes that a diverse staff, reflective of our community, is integral to our success. We hire talent at all levels regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, or disability, and actively foster inclusion within our company and across interactions with vendors and partners. Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact careers@tapblaze.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice

jobs.title: Salesforce Developer (US-Remote)
jobs.description: **Who is Tenable?** Tenable® is the Exposure Management company. Over 40,000 organizations around the globe rely on Tenable to understand and reduce cyber risk. Our global employees support 65 percent of the Fortune 500, 50 percent of the Global 2000, and large government agencies. Come be part of our journey! **What makes Tenable such a great place to work?** Ask a member of our team and they'll answer, "Our people!" We work together to build and innovate best\-in\-class cybersecurity solutions for our customers; all while creating a culture of belonging, respect, and excellence where we can be our best selves. When you're part of our \#OneTenable team, you can expect to partner with some of the most talented and passionate people in the industry, and have the support and resources you need to do work that truly matters. We deliver results that exceed expectations and we win together! **Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. without sponsorship. We are unable to provide sponsorship for work visas of any kind at the time of hire, or at any point during employment. This includes, but is not limited to: F1\-OPT, F1\-CPT, H\-1B, TN, J\-1, etc** **Your Role:** Tenable is looking for a Salesforce Developer to join our Business Technology team. This is a technical role — you are a builder first. You will own the design, development, and delivery of complex Salesforce solutions that power our go\-to\-market engine, including our Data Cloud platform, Agentforce AI automation, and core Sales, Service, and CPQ clouds. You write Apex and Lightning Web Components the way engineers write code: with testability, version control, and production deployments in mind. You are comfortable in a terminal, fluent with the Salesforce CLI, and you treat CI/CD pipelines as table stakes, not nice\-to\-haves. You will serve as a technical lead on the Business Technology Salesforce team, mentoring peers, setting development standards, and partnering directly with business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into elegant, scalable solutions. **Your Opportunity:** Platform Development * Design and build complex Salesforce solutions using Apex (classes, triggers, batch, async), Lightning Web Components (LWC), and declarative tooling (Flow, custom metadata). * Own the full development lifecycle: requirements analysis, technical design, code review, testing, and production deployment through sandbox environments using Salesforce CLI and SFDX. * Establish and enforce coding standards, test coverage requirements, and architectural best practices across the Salesforce platform. * Lead technical design reviews and contribute to a culture of engineering excellence on the BizTech team. Data Cloud \& AI * Build and maintain Data Cloud (Data 360\) data streams, data model objects (DMOs), calculated insights, and activation targets to support unified customer profiles. * Develop and configure Agentforce agents, Einstein AI features, and prompt templates to automate workflows and enhance the seller and support experience. * Collaborate with data engineering teams to integrate Salesforce with external data lakes (Databricks) using SQL, REST/SOAP APIs, and MuleSoft or direct connectors. * Write and optimize SQL queries for data validation, exploration, and pipeline debugging across Databricks and Salesforce Data Cloud. DevOps \& CI/CD * Manage the full deployment lifecycle across scratch orgs, sandboxes (dev, QA, staging, UAT), and production using Salesforce DX, SFDX CLI, and source\-driven development workflows. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Bitbucket, Jenkins, Coapdo, Gearset or equivalent) for automated testing, static analysis (PMD/ESLint), and deployment gating. * Champion version control best practices: branching strategy, pull request reviews, and release management in Git. * Comfortable operating in a terminal environment; able to script and automate routine tasks using shell, Python, or Node.js. Integrations \& Architecture * Design and implement integrations between Salesforce and external platforms including NetSuite, Workday, Clari, Certinia, and MuleSoft. * Evaluate and recommend platform architecture decisions, balancing declarative vs. programmatic approaches for scalability, performance, and maintainability. * Maintain data integrity, governor limit awareness, and security best practices (sharing rules, field\-level security, platform encryption) across all solutions. Collaboration \& Leadership * Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, and business analysts to translate complex requirements into technical specifications. * Conduct code reviews and provide constructive, educational feedback to developers and admins. * Develop and maintain technical documentation for system architecture, integration patterns, and deployment runbooks. **What You'll Need:** * **This position is US\-based only.** * 5\+ years of hands\-on Salesforce development experience in an enterprise environment. * Expert\-level proficiency in Apex (asynchronous patterns, governor limits, test\-driven development) and Lightning Web Components (LWC). * Strong working knowledge of Salesforce Data Cloud / Data 360: data streams, DMOs, identity resolution, segments, and activations. * Hands\-on experience with Salesforce CLI (SFDX), source\-driven development, and managing deployments through multiple sandbox environments to production. * Practical experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce (GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipelines, Jenkins, Gearset, Copado, or similar). * Proficiency in SQL; experience working with data lake platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or similar for data exploration, validation, and integration. * Comfort operating in a terminal/CLI environment; able to read, write, and debug shell commands and scripts independently. * Familiarity with Agentforce, Einstein AI features, or prompt\-based automation within the Salesforce platform. * Excellent communication skills; able to translate technical concepts for non\-technical stakeholders and lead design discussions with peers. * Self\-directed with a strong ownership mindset — you drive initiatives to completion without needing hand\-holding. * Exposure to AI\-assisted development tooling (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) and comfort integrating these into daily workflows. * May perform other duties and responsibilities that management may deem necessary from time to time. **And Ideally:** * Experience with MuleSoft, REST/SOAP API integration design, and event\-driven architecture (Platform Events, Change Data Capture). * Familiarity with NetSuite, Workday, Clari, or Certinia (FinancialForce) integrations. * Experience with Salesforce CPQ or Revenue Cloud. * Active Salesforce certifications: Platform Developer I \& II, Data Cloud Consultant, Application Architect, or Agentforce Specialist. * B2B SaaS or cybersecurity industry experience. \#LI\-Remote \#LI\-MM1 *We're committed to promoting Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) at Tenable \- through all equal employment opportunity laws and regulations at the international, federal, state and local levels. promotion. * Strong problem\-solving, critical\-thinking, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills. * Ability to work independently, manage changing priorities, and deliver in a Azure Data Lake Storage, or related integration services. * Experience with distributed ML libraries and frameworks such as scikit\-learn, XGBoost, LightGBM, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Spark MLlib. * eligible for annual discretionary bonus. * 401(k) plan with company match. * Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) Viking full\-time regular employees working in the United States can purchase Viking shares through payroll deductions. * Full benefits including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance at a highly subsidized rate (some plans are fully paid by Viking). * Accrue 15 paid vacation days, sick time accrual by state, and 6 paid holidays per year. * Opportunity to take a free and/or discounted cruise. * Highly subsidized gym membership. * Discounts on theatres, theme parks, movie tickets, travel discounts through IATA membership and too many more discounts to name. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next\-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match. **What you will do** -------------------- The Global Headquarters for Volvo Financial Services is seeking a Solution Engineer for the Finance Platform area of VFS Digital and IT. As a Solution Engineer, you will interact with digital product owners, solution engineers, DevSecOps engineers, scrum masters, and business stakeholders—including accounting and finance teams—to identify their needs and provide the right solutions and expertise. You will take a lead in delivery of a solution that best supports business and accounting requirements, using various techniques, products, and platforms. To do this, you balance various aspects of delivery from end to end, as well as proactively research advanced technology to find best practices and cost\-effective solutions. You will provide functional business and accounting solution support. You are a member of a stable team and will help manage product backlog, delivery, and support. Together with your colleagues at VFS and in the broad cross\-functional network at the Volvo Group, you will take responsibilities in the following areas: Responsibilities * Support the team in creating product specifications in the form of user stories with acceptance criteria, ensuring the stable team has all required information to deliver the desired outcome. * Help lead the product discovery process for assigned capabilities (including requirements gathering, design, and scoping) in collaboration with the digital product manager, data analysts, and engineers. * Work to understand full solution capability and functionality, becoming a true expert. * Interact closely with business stakeholders, including accounting teams, across multiple departments and countries. * Analyze and structure business and accounting requirements to propose solutions in line with system capabilities. * Support the solution/system development process by providing business, accounting, and technical best practices and identifying functionalities necessary to cover business needs. * Support release management, ensuring proper communication and full testing of changes, including accounting\-related validations. * Validate the functional and technical specifications and test cases, with a focus on financial accuracy and audit readiness. * Perform change management activities and prioritization of changes. * Recommend metrics to measure the performance of the solution in run\-time (operation), including financial accuracy and reconciliation efficiency. * Assess and make configuration changes on solution/system. * Together with technical and business teams, work on identifying, documenting, and resolving issues, incidents, and problems. * Identify opportunities for solution/system improvement, creating customer and financial value. * Provide expertise and knowledge in business capabilities, functional analysis, accounting workflows, process flows, and mapping with applications, group of applications, or application sub\-portfolios. * Support project teams with the implementation of solutions, including accounting modules and financial reporting tools. * Oversee managed services of solutions and applications in different markets globally. * Facilitate and chair meetings and workshops on solutions/applications. * Author presentations, spreadsheets, reports, and instructional material on solution functionalities, including accounting and finance features. * Participate in projects regarding systems development or acquisition, deployment, and rollout. **Your future team** -------------------- You will report directly to the Chapter Lead Solution Engineering, Finance Platform. Digital and IT is the engine of the VFS business, and we continue our strategic journey to further improve performance and to deliver the best customer experience in the industry. In this exciting environment, we are focused on Digital Innovation to meet the demands of our customers in an increasingly digitalized world. We develop Global Platforms to enable Financial Services expansion, we safeguard Market Flexibility, we explore Data Opportunities and engage Cybersecurity. Our Technology Office, Service Platform, and Customer Engagement teams take care of world\-class execution in all our markets, spanning the globe. In many of our markets, VFS has won the Great Place To Work award, where Great Work is done. By interacting with each other as an on\-site business, we build relationships, which allow us to work together more efficiently and form stronger bonds with our colleagues and customers. **Who are you?** ---------------- Do you dream big? We do too, and we are excited to grow together. In this role, we believe it is the right mindset that d presentation formats using storytelling and logical arguments. * Financial Services industry experience favorable, especially in accounting operations or financial control. * Experience working in an agile set\-up, using DevOps or similar. * The skills to identify risks and impacts regarding the functional solution from a business analysis perspective to propose changes in business processes, IT implementations, and/or operations when necessary. * Proficiency in English which enables you to take part in international projects. * A university degree in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Accounting, Finance, Business Analysis, or similar. * Ability to work in multi\-cultural and diverse environments, on\-site or remotely, together with communication experience at all levels of the organization. * Availability to travel internationally. At the Volvo Group, we strive for a clear, transparent, and straightforward compensation approach, motivating you to contribute to the company’s growth. For this position, the base pay is set at $96,000\.00 \- $118,500\.00 annually, and where applicable, bonus eligible. The range for this role, as well as final salary offered, is determined by several factors including, but not limited to, geographic location, work\-related knowledge, certifications, skills, education, and experience. In addition to these factors, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider internal equity of our current team members as part of any final offer. In addition to a solid package of compensation and benefits, plus you will enjoy:* Competitive medical, dental and vision insurance. * Generous paid time off. * Competitive matching retirement savings plans. * Working environment where your safety, health and wellbeing come first. * Focus on professional and personal development through Volvo Group University. * Programs that make today’s challenging reality of combining work and personal life easier. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. **Who we are and what we believe in** We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities. Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join **Volvo Group**. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment. At **Volvo Financial Services**, we are working together to shape the world we want to live in. As the captive finance arm of the Volvo Group, VFS provides financial services and solutions that meet the needs of our customers’ evolving business. Through our dedication to innovation, we support society in its adoption of sustainable transport and equipment solutions. VFS is headquartered inGothenburg, Sweden, and serves Volvo Group customers and dealers in more than 50 markets. **What’s in it for you?** We offer a solid and competitive package of compensation and benefits, plus you will enjoy a diverse working environment with a culture of care and inclusion. As an investment, we support your personal development and growth to achieve your career aspirations. Volvo Financial Services is an on\-site business and we understand that you might need occasional or temporary flexibility, which your leader is equipped to manage and fits well to our culture, as being together enables us to build upon our innovative and collaborative culture, as well as develop you for continued success.

jobs.title: Assistant Vice President, Product Management
jobs.description: ***Together we fight for everyone’s opportunity for a better financial future.*** We will do this together — with customers, partners and colleagues. We will fight for others, not against: We will stand up for and champion everyone’s access to opportunities. The status quo is not good enough … we believe every individual and every community deserves access to financial opportunities. We are determined to support both individuals and communities in reaching a better financial future. We know that reaching this future depends on our actions today. Like our Purpose Statement, Voya believes in being bold and committed to action. We are committed to a work environment where the differences that we are born with — and those we acquire throughout our lives — are understood, valued and intentionally pursued. We believe that our employees own our culture and have a responsibility to foster an environment where we all feel comfortable bringing our whole selves to work. Purposefully bringing our differences together to positively influence our culture, serve our clients and enrich our communities is essential to our vision. **Are you ready to join a company with a strong purpose and a winning culture? Start your Voyage –****Apply Now** *This is an exciting opportunity to own the technology product roadmap for Voya’s advisor experience — partnering with the field to identify the problems worth solving, then delivering the AI\-native tools that expand advisor capacity and improve client outcomes.* **ABOUT THE ROLE** ================== Voya Financial is hiring an Assistant Vice President of Product Management for the Advisor Experience. This role sits in the Digital \& Wealth Management Technology organization: you partner with the Wealth Management business and the advisor field to understand and prioritize the business problems worth solving, then own the technology product roadmap and the digital solutions that address them — across the RAD and Investor Channel advisor copilot, meeting preparation, client context, proposal generation (WealthPath), next\-best\-action, and book management. This is a product leadership role one level below VP, and you lead a small team of product managers executing against that roadmap. You work within the product strategy set by the VP of Digital Product for Wealth Management, but you own the technology roadmap, discovery, specifications, and outcomes for the advisor experience. The operating model is deliberate: the business owns its strategy and results and advisors own the client relationship; you partner with them to frame the problem, and you own the technology solution that solves it. This is a deeply hands\-on role: you write specs engineers actually use, evaluate AI prototype quality directly, make real\-time trade\-off calls, and partner daily with engineering. You are accountable for whether shipped products change advisor behavior, expand capacity, and improve client outcomes. This role reports to the VP of Digital Product for Wealth Management. Peer benchmarks: Senior/Principal Product Manager, Advisor Platform at Fidelity, Schwab, or LPL; Product Lead, Advisor Tools at a wealth\-focused fintech. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** ================== **Own the Advisor Experience Technology Product Roadmap** * Define and maintain a 12–18 month technology product roadmap across the advisor copilot, proposal generation, client context, and next\-best\-action — with clear prioritization rationale and measurable milestones. * Prioritize using advisor workflow research, adoption and usage data, field feedback, and competitive analysis; build the business cases that support investment decisions. * Define outcome\-oriented success metrics — advisor capacity and time saved, proposal cycle time, active adoption, advisor satisfaction, and downstream client funding and conversion — and own accountability for those numbers post\-launch. **Partner With the Business to Identify Problems \& Shape Solutions** * Partner with Wealth Management leadership, advisors (RAD and Investor Channel), field operations, and distribution to identify, frame, and prioritize the business problems worth solving, bringing engineering and AI feasibility into the conversation so the problem definition and the technology response are shaped together. * Lead structured discovery with advisors — including direct observation of how they actually work — translating advisor workflow problems into crisp product specs and the technology solutions that address them. * Write PRDs and technical specifications a small AI engineering team can execute against; define acceptance criteria that account for model quality thresholds, latency targets, and suitability and fiduciary output constraints. * Maintain working fluency in the advisor workflow: prospecting, meeting preparation, proposal and portfolio construction, ongoing service, and book management — well enough to identify where AI changes outcomes at each stage. **Drive AI\-Native Adviso isor\-productivity products at a broker\-dealer, RIA platform, asset manager, or wealth\-focused fintech. * CFP, CFA (or candidate), CIMA, or equivalent credentials. History of building 0* 1 AI products in an innovation lab or startup\-within\-a\-large\-institution context. * Hands\-on experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations or multi\-agent product design. * PMP, SAFe, or equivalent certification; voice\-of\-advisor research at scale (field studies, in\-product feedback loops, adoption cohort analysis). \#LI\-LW1 **Compensation Pay Disclosure:** Voya is committed to pay that’s fair and equitable, which means comparable pay for comparable roles and responsibilities. The below annual base salary range reflects the expected hiring range(s) for this position in the location(s) listed. In addition to base salary, Voya offers incentive opportunities (i.e., annual cash incentives, sales incentives, and/or long\-term incentives) based on the role to reward the achievement of annual performance objectives. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Voya Financial is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Actual compensation offered may vary from the posted salary range based upon the candidate’s geographic location, work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level and will be finalized at the time of offer. Salaries for part\-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked. $171,300 \- $214,120 USD**Be Well. Stay Well.** Voya provides the resources that can make a difference in your lives. To us, this means thriving physically, financially, socially and emotionally. Voya benefits are designed to help you do just that. That’s why we offer an array of plans, programs, tools and resources with one goal in mind: To help you and your family be well and stay well. **What We Offer** * Health, dental, vision and life insurance plans * 401(k) Savings plan – with generous company matching contributions (up to 6%) * Voya Retirement Plan – employer paid cash balance retirement plan (4%) * Tuition reimbursement up to $5,250/year * Paid time off – including 20 days paid time off, nine paid company holidays and a flexible Diversity Celebration Day. * Paid volunteer time — 40 hours per calendar year **Critical Skills** At Voya, we have identified the following critical skills which are key to success in our culture: * **Customer Focused**: Passionate drive to delight our customers and offer unique solutions that deliver on their expectations. * **Critical Thinking**: Thoughtful process of analyzing data and problem solving data to reach a well\-reasoned solution. * **Team Mentality**: Partnering effectively to drive our culture and execute on our common goals. * **Business Acumen**: Appreciation and understanding of the financial services industry in order to make sound business decisions. * **Learning Agility**: Openness to new ways of thinking and acquiring new skills to retain a competitive advantage. **Equal Employment Opportunity** *Voya Financial is an equal\-opportunity employer. Voya Financial provides equal opportunity to qualified individuals regardless of race, color, sex, national origin, citizenship status, religion, age, disability, veteran status, creed, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other status protected by state or local law.* **Reasonable Accommodations** *Voya is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Voya will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment,* *please* *reference* *resources for applicants with disabilities**.*

jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist, AI Studio
jobs.description: **Job Description:** We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. Here, your curiosity fuels progress, your voice shapes innovation, and your ambition helps redefine what’s possible within science and learning. We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large. **About the Role:** The Senior Applied Scientist serves as a senior scientific authority for AI Studio, setting the scientific approach and quality bar across multiple engagement pods and mentoring Applied Scientists embedded in individual pods. As part of Wiley’s applied AI professional services practice, the role combines deep domain expertise with applied problem\-solving to translate real\-world research challenges into scientifically rigorous, deployable AI\-enabled solutions and ensure consistent quality across AI Studio’s full portfolio of engagements. The position requires working directly with customers such as pharmaceutical companies, biotech firms, and materials science organizations to embed AI into evidence\-intensive research processes, often on engagements with undefined or evolving scientific requirements. The Senior Applied Scientist ensures solutions are grounded in authoritative scientific knowledge and meet rigorous standards for accuracy and reliability, while shaping product direction, extending delivery capacity through external partners, and building Wiley’s scientific credibility in the market. **Job Responsibilities:** *Scientific leadership across engagements* * Set the scientific approach and quality standard across multiple AI Studio engagement pods, not limited to a single active engagement * Serve as a technical escalation point and mentor for Applied Scientists on complex or high\-ambiguity engagements; review scientific approach and outputs across engagements to ensure consistency and rigor * Operate with minimal oversight on engagements with undefined or evolving scientific requirements, establishing approach where no established playbook exists * Partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineers to bridge scientific and technical domains, ensuring successful solution implementation *Delivery partner ecosystem ownership* * Own AI Studio’s external delivery partner ecosystem (e.g., Prolego, Cactus, and other delivery providers extending AI Studio’s delivery capacity), including: * Establishing scientific standards and governance processes partners must meet * Defining quality expectations and evaluation criteria for partner\-delivered scientific work * Managing partner performance against those standards, including escalation and remediation when work falls short * Define and monitor service levels, delivery KPIs, capacity commitments, and operating rhythms for external delivery partners. * Coordinate with Procurement, Legal, Finance, and business stakeholders on partner onboarding, statements of work, contractual requirements, and renewals. * Forecast external delivery capacity and recommend the appropriate partner allocation based on scientific expertise, delivery needs, quality, and commercial considerations. *Product and platform influence* * Partner with Product leadership to define scientific requirements, validation frameworks, and customer\-driven enhancements that influence the ARI platform roadmap * Validate product credibility and fitness for use from a scientific standpoint, and provide domain expertise that shapes product positioning *Pre\-sales and customer strategy* * Lead scientific feasibility assessment in pre\-sales and early scoping discussions, with authority to determine scientific viability and recommend that engagements be reshaped or declined on scientific grounds. * Serve as a senior scientific partner for strategic accounts, building trusted relationships with R\&D leaders and identifying opportunities for repeat or expanded engagements in collaboration with Sales and account leadership. *External credibility and thought leadership* * Represent Wiley’s scientific credibility through publications, speaking engagements, authored technical content, and engagement with customers and the broader scientific community, establishing AI Studio’s authority in pharma AI and other relevant domains. *Standards and delivery model* * Ensure all solutions across engagements and partner\-delivered work leverage authoritative data sources, including peer\-reviewed research, and adhere to relevant scientific and regulatory standards Operate effectively in sprint\-based delivery models with defined outcomes, tight timelines, and direct accountability to customers — while setting the bar others are held to * **Required Qualifications:** * Advanced degree in a relevant scientific discipline (PhD preferred) * Extensive post\-doctoral or industry research experience (8–10\+ years), ideally in: * o Pharmaceutical or biotech organizations * o Contract rese ist level) Demonstrated ability to: * Make final scientific calls on ambiguous or contested AI outputs without escalation * Evaluate AI\-generated outputs and third\-party/partner\-delivered scientific work for accuracy, grounding, and reliability * Apply critical thinking to determine fitness of AI solutions for real\-world scientific use * Experience with research workflows in evidence\-intensive environments and deep understanding of how scientific knowledge is generated, validated, and applied * Strong communication skills, including the ability to: * o Translate between scientific and technical audiences * o Present complex findings to senior stakeholders, including in pre\-sales and executive contexts * o Write clearly for both expert and non\-expert audiences, including externally published or presented content * · Experience operating outside traditional academic environments, including: * o Managing ambiguous, undefined problems with minimal oversight * o Delivering against defined outcomes under time constraints * o Working directly with external stakeholders, including third\-party delivery partners * Experience managing or governing third\-party vendors or delivery partners (preferred) * Familiarity with AI tools or applications in a research context (preferred) * Industry\-specific expertise (depending on focus area), such as: * o Life sciences (e.g., pharmacology, clinical research, regulatory science) and understanding of regulatory standards o Chemistry, materials science, or engineering, with experience in experimental or quantitative research * **We power infinite possibilities.** For more than 200 years, we've transformed knowledge into discoveries that shape the world. Today, our global team of innovators, creators, and experts is driving what's next in science, education, and publishing—creating impact that reaches everywhere. We're not just observers of progress. We're the ones accelerating scientific breakthroughs, advancing learning, and sparking innovation that redefines entire fields and improves lives. Here, your talent matters. Your ideas have room to grow. And your work creates breakthroughs that can change everything. Wiley is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. We evaluate all qualified applicants and treat all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. Wiley is also committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants and employees with disabilities. Applicants who require accommodation to participate in the job application process may contact tasupport@wiley.com for assistance. We are proud that our workplace promotes continual learning and internal mobility. We offer meeting\-free Friday afternoons allowing more time for heads down work and professional development, and through a robust body of employee programing we facilitate a wide range of opportunities to foster community, learn, and grow. We are committed to fair, transparent pay, and we strive to provide competitive compensation in addition to a comprehensive benefits package. The range below represents Wiley's good faith and reasonable estimate of the base pay for this role at the time of posting roles in the United Kingdom, Canada, USA, Austria, Czechia, Denmark, France, Greece, Italy, Netherlands, Romania, or Spain. It is anticipated that most qualified candidates will fall within the range, however the ultimate salary offered for this role may be higher or lower and will be set based on a variety of non\-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to, geographic location, skills, and competencies. When applying, please attach your resume/CV to be considered. **Salary Range:** 145,200\.00 USD to 212,800\.00 USD\&\#xa;\&\#xa;\#LI\-JG1

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer - Agent Platform
jobs.description: **Your work days are brighter here.** We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. **About the Team** The Agent Platform team delivers a new AI focused experience for Workday customers, and most importantly their employees. We are at the forefront of Workday’s AI \& Agentic initiatives with the objective to deliver and integrate Agentic capabilities across the entire Workday platform, including the widespread adoption and AI powered Assist features, rapid creation and deployment of Workday\-native AI Agents, and the delivery of Workday’s Agent System of Record. Focus Area: Data Engineering \& Trust Systems We are seeking to engineer the intelligent data backbone and verified trust systems that power Workday’s AI and Agents. This role will specifically be part of the Agent Trust and Inspection team, with responsibilities including Agent Safety Scanning, Attestation, Observability, and enhancing the Customer Experience for Agent Management. This is a unique opportunity at the intersection of Agent development, operation, security, and identity. Why Join the Agent Platform Team? The Data \& Frontier: Tackle unique challenges in Agentic AI utilizing Workday’s exclusive, high\-integrity enterprise datasets. Impact at Scale: Your contributions will act as the crucial optimizer and gatekeeper of quality for products that reach 31 million global users. People\-First Culture: We cultivate a culture that balances high\-intensity innovation with a strong commitment to sustainable work\-life integration. Who We're Looking For: We are looking for creative, results\-oriented, and collaborative Full\-Stack Engineers to help build and scale the next generation of our Agentic system. **About the Role** As a Full Stack Engineer in the Agent Trust and inspection team, you’ll help build the user\-facing and platform experiences that increase trust AI agents .Working within a small, cross\-functional pod, you’ll design and ship full stack solutions—from intuitive front\-end experiences to resilient backend services that integrate AI\-driven capabilities deeply into HR and Finance workflows. This role is about turning powerful technology into products people actually use: scalable, reliable systems that simplify complex business processes for customers around the world. You’ll collaborate closely with machine learning engineers, product managers, security partners and platform teams, owning features end to end and seeing your work run in production. If you enjoy building real products, solving meaningful problems, and working with people who care about quality and craft, you’ll feel right at home here. **Your responsibilities:** * Build and deliver full stack features that power AI agents security Own services and experiences from development through production, you build it, you run it * Collaborate in an iterative, team\-first environment that values strong engineering practices and continuous learning * Share knowledge, mentor teammates, and help raise the technical bar across the pod **About You** **Basic Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of experience in software engineering * 2\+ years experience writing performant backend services(Java Spring boot/GO/Python/any modern OOP language) * 2\+ years of experience with React and Typescript for Front End / Full stack development * 2\+ years experience in deploying applications on public cloud or/and Kubernetes **Other Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in a computer related field or equivalent work experience * Familiarity with agentic coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor * Experience building and operating products in cloud environments (AWS preferred/GCP/Azure) * Familiarity with cryptographic libraries for implementing digital signatures and attestation verification * Knowledge of software development best practices (DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing, observability) * Hands\-on experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) * Proven success working within fast\-paced, agile environments and cross\-functional teams * Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with both technical and non\-technical partners **Workday Pay Transparency Statement** The annualized base salary ranges for the primary location and any additional locations are listed below. Workday pay ranges vary based on work location. As a part of the total compensation package, this role may be eligible for the Workday Bonus Plan or a role\-specific commission/bonus, as well as annual refresh stock grants. Recruiters can share more detail during the hiring process. Each candidate’s compensation offer will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, geography, experience, skills, job duties, and business need, among other things. For more information regarding Workday’s comprehensive benefits, please click here . Primary Location: USA.CO.Boulder Primary Location Base Pay Range: $130,400 USD \- $195,600 USD Additional US Location(s) Base Pay Range: $123,900 USD \- $222,000 USD Additional Considerations: The application deadline for this role is the same as the posting end date stated as below: 09/18/2026 **Our Approach to Flexible Work** With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter. Pursuant to applicable Fair Chance law, Workday will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Workday is an Equal Opportunity Employer including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision\-making to any degree. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law. Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com , as far in advance as possible. **Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!** At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. jobs.title: Developer Community Manager
jobs.description: **About Us** At You.com, we are building the AI Search Infrastructure that powers modern AI systems. Our goal is to create the trusted knowledge layer that agents, applications, and enterprises rely on to retrieve real\-time, accurate, and citation\-backed information. Our platform combines proprietary vertical indexes with LLM\-optimized retrieval systems to power AI agents, applications, and enterprise workflows. We are solving hard problems across search, large language models, and large\-scale infrastructure to make AI systems more reliable, transparent, and useful. Our team includes engineers, researchers, product builders, and operators who care about solving meaningful problems and delivering real\-world impact. Whether you are improving core infrastructure, shaping product experiences, or helping bring new AI capabilities to market, your work will help define how modern AI finds and uses knowledge. **About the Role** In this role, you will create meaningful reasons for developers to engage with You.com and with each other — through events, workshops, hackathons, partnerships, online communities, and ongoing programming. You will build strong local communities in San Francisco and New York while helping turn those relationships into product adoption, advocacy, and long\-term affinity for You.com. You will work closely with DevRel, Product, Marketing, Partnerships, and Sales to connect our developer community directly to the products we are building and the problems developers are trying to solve. This role is for someone who genuinely enjoys being part of technical communities, knows how to bring the right people together, and understands that a great developer community isn't measured by how many people show up — it's measured by what they build, whether they come back, and whether they bring others with them. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Own You.com's developer community strategy and programming in San Francisco and New York City, establishing a consistent presence in two of the world's most important AI ecosystems * Build relationships with AI engineers, founders, researchers, technical leaders, developer groups, startups, universities, and other influential members of the local developer ecosystem * Develop a regular cadence of high\-quality community programming, including meetups, technical workshops, hackathons, builder dinners, office hours, and other formats that developers genuinely want to attend * Turn You.com's SF and NYC hubs into destinations for the AI builder community, creating recurring opportunities for developers to learn, build, and connect * Partner with DevRel and Product to create hands\-on experiences that get developers building with You.com's APIs, reducing the distance between attending a community event and making a first API call * Identify and cultivate community champions and power users who can become advocates, contributors, speakers, and long\-term partners for You.com * Build relationships with complementary developer platforms, AI communities, accelerators, open\-source projects, and ecosystem partners to expand our reach * Maintain an authentic presence in the online communities where AI developers spend their time, including X, LinkedIn, GitHub, Discord, Hacker News, and emerging communities * Create feedback loops between the developer community and our Product and Engineering teams, surfacing recurring questions, friction points, use cases, and product opportunities * Partner with Marketing to amplify the people, projects, demos, and stories emerging from our community * Develop scalable community programs that allow You.com to support builders beyond individual events * Establish clear goals and measurement across community growth, event participation, API signups, activation, product usage, advocacy, and community\-sourced pipeline * Represent You.com at developer conferences, meetups, hackathons, and other technical community events **Qualifications** ------------------ * Experience building or managing a developer, technical, startup, or AI community * Strong existing relationships within the AI and developer ecosystem, particularly in San Francisco and/or New York * Demonstrated ability to create events and programs that technical audiences choose to participate in repeatedly * Strong understanding of how developers discover, evaluate, adopt, and advocate for developer tools and APIs * Technically fluent enough to have credible conversations with engineers about APIs, AI agents, LLMs, developer infrastructure, and modern AI application development * Comfortable getting hands\-on with developer products and learning enough to demonstrate and discuss them authentically * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage developers without sounding like traditional corporate marketing * Experience collaborating across DevRel, Product, Marketing, Partnerships, and Sales * Highly proactive and comfortable building programs from scratch rather than inheriting an established community playbook * Data\-driven approach to community building, with an understanding of how community engagement can translate into product adoption, retention, advocacy, and pipeline * Experience in AI infrastructure, developer tools, APIs, or open\-source communities strongly preferred * Active participation in developer or AI communities is a plus Our salary bands are structured based on a combination of geographic tiers and internal leveling. Compensation is determined by multiple factors assessed during the interview process, with the final offer reflecting these considerations. Salary Band $180,000 \- $220,000 USD #### **Company Perks:** * Hubs in San Francisco and New York City offering regular in\-person gatherings and co\-working sessions * Flexible PTO with U.S. holidays observed and a week shutdown in December to rest and recharge\* * A competitive health insurance plan covers 100% of the policyholder and 75% for dependents\* * 12 weeks of paid parental leave in the US\* * 401k program, 3% match \- vested immediately!\* * $500 work\-from\-home stipend to be used up to a year of your start date\* * $600 technology stipend to support a portion of our hybrid/remote team's cell phone and internet expenses\* * $1,200 per year Health \& Wellness Allowance to support your personal goals\* * The chance to collaborate with a team at the forefront of AI research * Certain perks and benefits are limited to full\-time employees only *You.com participates in E\-Verify. We will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee’s Form I\-9 to confirm work authorization. (English/Spanish:* *E\-Verify Participation**/**Right to Work**) We are also an inclusive, equitable, and accessible workplace. Please let us know if you require accommodation for any portion of the recruitment and hiring process.* #### **Beware of Recruiting Scams:** You.com will only contact you through official @You.com email addresses and will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. #### **Use of AI Tools During Our Hiring Process:** At You.com, we're thoughtful about how we use AI throughout our business — including our hiring process. During certain stages of the interview process, we may use AI\-powered tools to assist with administrative tasks such as scheduling, note\-taking, transcription, or summarizing interview discussions. These tools are intended to support our interviewers by improving accuracy and efficiency — they do not make hiring decisions or replace human judgment. All employment decisions are made by our recruiting team and hiring managers based on a holistic review of each candidate and applicable evaluation criteria. If AI\-assisted note\-taking or transcription may be used during your interview, we will notify you in advance. If you prefer not to participate in an interview that uses these tools, you may opt out by informing your recruiter before your scheduled interview. We will work with you to provide an alternative interview experience where reasonably practicable. Information collected during the hiring process is handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy and applicable law. By continuing with the application process, you acknowledge that you have read this notice. If AI\-assisted tools are used during your interview and you have not opted out after receiving notice, you consent to their use as described above, where permitted by applicable law.

jobs.title: Senior AI Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description:** Younessi Law is a leading plaintiff firm with a strong focus on employment, personal injury, and workers’ compensation matters, recognized for over 30 years of service in Los Angeles. The firm has successfully represented thousands of clients, providing dedicated advocacy and high\-quality legal support. Team members work in a dynamic, friendly, and collaborative environment that values professionalism and client\-centered service. Younessi Law offers competitive compensation, paid time off, bonuses, reimbursements, and health\-related benefits, supporting long\-term career growth and stability for legal and technical professionals. **Role Description** The Senior AI Systems Engineer – On\-Premise AI will design, implement, and maintain on\-premise AI infrastructure and platforms that support Younessi Law’s internal operations and case management workflows. This full\-time, on\-site role in Los Angeles involves architecting robust AI systems, integrating machine learning tools with existing legal systems, and ensuring secure data handling for sensitive case information. The engineer will perform day\-to\-day monitoring of system performance, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and optimize configurations for reliability, scalability, and compliance. Responsibilities include collaborating with attorneys and operations staff to translate business requirements into technical solutions, documenting system designs and standard operating procedures, and coordinating with external vendors or IT teams when needed. The role also includes proactive capacity planning, periodic upgrades, and continuous improvement of AI\-driven tools to enhance efficiency and decision support. **Qualifications** * Strong Systems Engineering and Systems Design skills to architect, implement, and scale on\-premise AI platforms. * Proficiency in System Administration and Technical Support to maintain, secure, and support production systems for end users. * Advanced Troubleshooting capabilities to diagnose and resolve complex hardware, software, and integration issues. * Experience with AI/ML infrastructure (e.g., GPU servers, containerization, orchestration tools) and on\-premise deployments. * Knowledge of networking, security best practices, and data protection in environments handling confidential information. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related technical field; advanced degree is a plus. * Experience working in or supporting professional services or legal environments is beneficial. * Strong communication skills, ability to collaborate with non\-technical stakeholders, and a track record of working on\-site in cross\-functional teams. Submit your resume: careers@younessilaw.com Job Type: Full\-time Pay: From $40\.00 per hour Benefits: * 401(k) * Health insurance * Paid time off Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: * San Jose, California, United States * Full time **What You Can Expect** In this role, you will design and ship AI\-powered features within Zoom's Workforce Engagement Management (WEM) platform, directly improving how enterprise organizations forecast, schedule, and coach their teams. Working alongside experienced engineers, product managers, and data scientists, you will take ownership of features from initial design through production deployment. You will contribute to some of the most forward\-looking work in the WEM space, from LLM\-powered simulation environments to intelligent notification systems and AI\-driven quality scoring pipelines. This is a hands\-on role with meaningful mentorship from senior engineers and real impact on thousands of enterprise users from day one. This is a hybrid position that requires on\-site presence 3 days per week at our San Jose, CA office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role. **About the Team** The Workforce Engagement Management team at Zoom builds intelligent systems that help organizations manage, forecast, and optimize workforce performance. Our suite of WFM and QM products sits at the intersection of AI and enterprise collaboration, and we are actively pioneering the use of generative AI and LLMs to shape the next generation of contact center experiences. new graduates are welcome to apply. * Experience or coursework in prompt engineering, LLM fine\-tuning, or AI workflow orchestration (internship or project experience counts). * Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across functions. * Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerized deployments (Docker/Kubernetes), or MLOps tooling is a plus. **Salary Range or On Target Earnings:** Minimum: $73,300\.00 Maximum: $169,500\.00 In addition to the base salary and/or OTE listed Zoom has a Total Direct Compensation philosophy that takes into consideration; The work style of each role, Hybrid, Remote, or In\-Person is indicated in the job description/posting. **Benefits** As part of our award\-winning workplace culture and commitment to delivering happiness, our benefits program offers a variety of perks, benefits, and options to help employees maintain their physical, mental, emotional, and financial health; support work\-life balance; and contribute to their community in meaningful ways. **About Us** Zoomies help people stay connected so they can get more done together. We’re problem\-solvers, working at a fast pace to design solutions with our customers and users in mind. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Pipeline Infrastructure & Integration
jobs.description: The Software Systems Engineering team is responsible for defining SW development processes and ensuring that all safety\-critical software meets a high safety bar for production vehicles. In this role, you will design and implement methodologies, tools, and processes for safety\-critical software that will revolutionize transportation in the 21st century. Borrowing principles from avionics, automotive, and other safety\-critical industries, you will work with software engineers throughout the Zoox software org, ranging from state\-of\-the\-art AI Autonomy software, all the way to highly\-critical RTOS and middleware components. You will develop and maintain tools that help cross\-functional teams build software adhering to a High Assurance Process, working closely with CI tools and infrastructure to meet the team's business goals. Partnering with team leads, you will define delivery milestones, automate necessary tooling, and report on relevant business metrics — while contributing to code reviews and incident postmortems to ensure the long\-term stability and reliability of the software system. ### **In this role, you will:** * Be the go\-to owner for the entire SSE pipeline ecosystem — from ClangTidy, ASAN/TSAN/Harden, and FBInfer — keeping every pipeline running smoothly across weekly, nightly, and CI so the rest of the org can trust the results. * Take pipelines from prototypes to fully deployed, CI\-enforced systems across branches, shaping how "production\-grade" looks for stability tooling at Zoox. * Turn raw issue data into dashboards and KPIs that tell a story — giving leadership and engineering teams a clear, real\-time pulse on pipeline health and software quality trends. * Play detective when things break — root\-causing gnarly cross\-platform and determinism, building the instrumentation and tooling to crack them. * Help shape what's next for the pipeline suite — pitching in on new checker rollouts, testing strategy, and define how SSE scales its infrastructure ### **Qualifications:** * Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in computer science, electrical engineering, robotics, aerospace, or related fields and 3\+ years of experience working on large code bases * Experience developing in Bazel/Python, setting up backend infrastructure (databases, web servers, shell scripts, etc.), and interfacing with software written in C\+\+ and Python. * Experienced in drafting system design diagrams and documentation for customer communication and long\-term maintenance * Comfortable to whip up quick scripts to automate tasks, such as generating metrics, establishing traceability, etc, when necessary. * Deep experience in enterprise\-scale deployment practices and issues ### **Bonus Qualifications:** * Experience working with PipeDream, Airflow and Looker * Proficiency in ReactJS, TypeScript and C\+\+ (C\+\+11, C\+\+14, C\+\+17\) including memory management, threading, and common debugging pattern There are three major components to compensation for this position: salary, Amazon Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), and Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights. A sign\-on bonus may be offered as part of the compensation package. The listed range applies only to the base salary. Compensation will vary based on geographic location and level. Leveling, as well as positioning within a level, is determined by a range of factors, including, but not limited to, a candidate's relevant years of experience, domain knowledge, and interview performance. The salary range listed in this posting is representative of the range of levels Zoox is considering for this position. Zoox also offers a comprehensive package of benefits, including paid time off (e.g. sick leave, vacation, bereavement), unpaid time off, Zoox Stock Appreciation Rights, Amazon RSUs, health insurance, long\-term care insurance, long\-term and short\-term disability insurance, and life insurance.**About Zoox** Zoox is developing the first ground\-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility\-as\-a\-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast\-moving and highly execution\-oriented team. Follow us on LinkedIn **Accommodations** If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter. ***A Final Note:****You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. jobs.title: AI Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **This is a hybrid position requiring in\-office attendance three days per week at our Atlanta office. technologies for data analysis and decision\-making. * Design, build, and maintain the technical infrastructure required to enable AI, including custom tools, server\-side logic, system integrations, like data acquisition, cleaning, and preparation. * Experience with data warehousing (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake) and a solid understanding of data modeling. * Improve team productivity through the identification and implementation of AI solutions that automate or optimize key workflows for the Finance team. * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field. **The impact you will have in expert for AI implementation within Finance. **The impact you will have in 12 Months:** * You will be proactively identifying new, complex business problems to solve with AI and scaling your solutions, potentially with other teams. * You will be contributing to broader engineering discussions about AI best practices and helping to shape the future of AI automation at Fullstory. \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-CD1 ### **About Fullstory** Fullstory is a leading behavioral data platform transforming how businesses understand and improve their digital experiences. Our technology empowers companies to uncover insights, optimize customer and employee journeys, and deliver exceptional online interactions. Fullstory offers sponsored benefit packages for US\-based Fullstorians, and supplemental coverage options for international Fullstorians. * **Learning opportunities.** We provide professional development opportunities through training programs and an annual learning subsidy for US and EMEA\-based employees. * **Productivity support.** US and EMEA\-based Fullstorians receive a monthly productivity stipend. * **Team Collaboration.** Connect with fellow Fullstorians through team off\-sites and an annual full\-company meet\-up. * **Paid parental leave.** Fullstorians balance the needs of their growing families without the added stress of figuring out work and finances. * **Bereavement leave, including miscarriage/pregnancy loss**.
